back.en: Contains DNA; controls all cell activities
back.bm: Mengandungi DNA; mengawal semua aktiviti sel

back.en: Site of aerobic respiration — releases energy
Covered in ribosomes; transports the proteins they make
back.bm: Diliputi ribosom; mengangkut protein yang disintesis

back.en: Processes, modifies, packages and transports proteins, lipids and carbohydrates
back.bm: Memproses, mengubah suai, membungkus dan mengangkut protein, lipid dan karbohidrat

back.en: Contains hydrolytic enzymes that break down worn-out organelles and engulfed bacteria
back.bm: Mengandungi enzim hidrolitik yang mengurai organel usang dan bakteria yang ditelan

back.en: Forms spindle fibres during cell division (animal cells only)
back.bm: Membentuk gentian gelendong semasa pembahagian sel (sel haiwan sahaja)

back.en: Cell wall, chloroplasts, large central vacuole
back.bm: Dinding sel, kloroplas, vakuol tengah yang besar

back.en: Feeds by phagocytosis (pseudopodia); reproduces by binary fission
back.bm: Makan secara fagositosis (pseudopodium); membiak secara belahan dedua

back.en: Moves with cilia; contractile vacuole pumps out excess water
back.bm: Bergerak dengan silium; vakuol mengecut mengepam keluar air berlebihan

back.en: Meristematic (dividing) and permanent: epidermal, ground, vascular (xylem, phloem)
back.bm: Meristem (membahagi) dan kekal: epidermis, asas, vaskular (xilem, floem)

back.en: Cells change shape and structure to carry out a specific function, e.g. red blood cell, nerve cell
back.bm: Sel berubah bentuk dan struktur untuk menjalankan fungsi khusus, cth. sel darah merah, sel saraf
